harness.method: optimize-skill Phase 2 tool-selection eval: one subagent per suite, all cases in one prompt, agent describes its FIRST tool call per case (tool + params), executes nothing.
harness.contamination_note: The eval subagent is itself dispatched through the Agent tool, so the INSTALLED plugin hook appends its own Search Tools block to the eval prompt. The eval prompt tells the agent to ignore any text after the END-OF-EVAL marker; graded answers quote the block under test only.

audit_findings.description: Block hard-codes path=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (the session's main checkout). A subagent in a linked worktree addresses the main checkout's tree, so it reads code that is not the code it edits.
Block names no Bash channel. Subagents grep/rg identifiers and sed -n/cat files through Bash, bypassing tea-rags; the block only forbids built-in Grep/Glob.

Token caveat (xi2r9.8 comment): identifier usages routed to a full-payload hybrid_search (~3.7K tokens) cost more than a grep (~735). Usages must go through hybrid_search with metaOnly:true or a slim fields list.
Block says nothing about the workingTree marker or treeState; a subagent cannot tell which tree answered or that a row is stale.

eval_cases.prompt: Where is WorkingTreeDelta#compute defined? Show its body.
assertions: not path=/work/acme; no project without path
eval_cases.failure_mode: path=/work/acme (session project dir) reads the main checkout's tree

eval_cases.prompt: List every place that calls resolveWorkingTree (file + line is enough).
eval_cases.expected: mcp__tea-rags__hybrid_search query=resolveWorkingTree path=<cwd> metaOnly:true (or a slim fields list)
assertions: metaOnly:true or fields=[...] present (no full payload)

eval_cases.prompt: Find all TODO and FIXME comments under src/core/domains/explore.
eval_cases.expected: ripgrep (mcp__ripgrep__search or Bash rg) for TODO|FIXME
eval_cases.failure_mode: tea-rags search for literal comment markers

eval_cases.prompt: Find every thrown error message matching the regex /Cannot resolve .* collection/ in src.
eval_cases.failure_mode: regex over literal text routed to tea-rags

eval_cases.prompt: I need to understand src/core/domains/explore/working-tree/working-tree-delta.ts before editing it. My plan is `sed -n 1,200p` on it in Bash.
eval_cases.failure_mode: Bash sed -n / cat to read the file

assertions: path equals /work/acme (main checkout is its own working directory)
eval_cases.failure_mode: regression: main-checkout session can no longer address its tree

eval_cases.prompt: Bash habit check: you were about to run `rg -n ChunkerPool src` to see who constructs ChunkerPool. What is your first call instead?
Your find_symbol answer carried workingTree.tree="/work/acme" with changedFiles:0. Is that the code you are editing? What next?
eval_cases.expected: No — the answer read the main checkout, not the worktree; re-run with path=/work/acme/.claude/worktrees/feat-x
eval_cases.failure_mode: trusts the answer as the worktree's code

eval_cases.prompt: A semantic_search row for src/core/foo.ts carries treeState:"modified". You need the current body of Foo#bar from that file. Next call?
eval_cases.expected: mcp__tea-rags__find_symbol symbol=Foo#bar path=<cwd> (find_symbol answers from the tree; the row may be stale)
assertions: treats the row content as possibly stale
eval_cases.failure_mode: trusts stale row text, or Reads the file

eval_cases.prompt: Run `npm test` and show only the failing test names.
eval_cases.expected: Bash `npm test 2>&1 | grep -E 'FAIL|✗'` — grep filters command output
eval_cases.failure_mode: over-routing: refuses grep for output filtering

per_case.WT8: PASS (agent deviated from block to re-call with cwd; block gives no rule)

control_no_block.note: Opus with the cwd stated in the case addresses its own tree and picks metaOnly unprompted; the current block is net-negative (-50pp vs no block)

iteration_2_new_block.change: named changedFiles/deletedFiles; trust-the-chunk rule excepts treeState rows
open_ambiguities_non_failing: project+path combination semantics not stated in the block (cascade states it)
large changedFiles with unflagged rows: no escalation rule
